status: Agreed generation contract; plan and source hashes are recorded separately before dataset generation
partition_rule: From the v11 reserved pool of1792 IDs, exclude29 preview/smoke-exposed IDs. Rank the remaining1763 IDs by SHA256('HyperNet-v12-2D-fresh-family-split-1:'+decimalID). First128 DEV,next128 TEST. Distractors exclusively from the same partition, excluding enrolled family. No model scores enter selection.
freshness_rule: All model/scorer selection is finished and hash-frozen before fresh image generation. New v12 seed namespace. Prior v11 main/preview raw-file and decoded-pixel hashes are excluded. Fresh DEV calibrates thresholds only; fresh TEST is evaluation-only; no fresh training rows.

targets_npz.union_mask: bool[256,256]; union of all rendered foreground shapes
targets_npz.target_mask: bool[256,256]; enrolled microvariant foreground on positives, allFalse on negatives
targets_npz.candidate_mask: bool[256,256]; candidate foreground for provenance and diagnostics only

bbox_convention: xyxy in pixel coordinates; exclusive right/bottom; tight foreground bounds
counterbalance: Two enrollment variants per family. Shared candidate scene pixels are intentionally reused with opposite labels, making presence depend on the support. No shared grammar families or seeds with v11 main/preview/smoke exposures; fresh DEV/TEST family splits and pixels are disjoint. Candidate query is an independently jittered macro instance, with +/-3% axis/connector variation from support. Both microstates have equal continuous removed area and primitive count; rasterized ink counts can differ slightly.
inference_access: Model receives only support RGB/support box and query RGB. Query boxes, masks, object roles, family labels and presence labels are evaluation targets, never inference inputs.
scope: Heldout grammar combinations share designed mathematical building blocks; they are not new semantic natural-object categories. No natural images or external pretrained weights.
